name: Green Bean Casserole
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 2 ⅔ cups canned French fried onions, divided into 2 equal portions
2 cans (21 ounces) cream of mushroom soup

steps: Stir together beans, milk, ½ of onions, pepper, soup, and soy sauce in a 3-quart casserole dish.
Sprinkle top with rest of onions.

culture.text: Green bean casserole was invented in 1955 by the Campbell Soup Company. It has since become a popular Thanksgiving side dish in the United States.
